examples.title: Example 1: Implementing an Efficiency-oriented Subheader
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement a subheader where the left side contains an icon and a secondary title, and the right side has a text button.

examples.title: Example 2: Implementing a Double-Line Text Content Subheader
examples.description: This example showcases a subheader with a primary title and a secondary title on the left, and a text button with a right arrow on the right.

examples.title: Example 3: Implementing a Spinner Content Subheader
examples.description: This example showcases a subheader with content and events for selection on the left, and an icon-attached button on the right.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Icon Symbol for the Left Side
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the icon symbol for the left side of the subheader.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Icon Symbol for the Right Side
examples.description: The following example shows how to set operationType to OperationType.ICON_GROUP for the right side of the subheader, with operationItem set to a symbol icon.

examples.title: Example 6: Customizing Title Content
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the title content with a titleBuilder object for the SubHeaderV2 component.

examples.title: Example 7: Customizing the Title Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set custom font styles for the primary and secondary titles in the SubHeaderV2 component.

examples.title: Example 8: Implementing Announcement for the Button on the Right Side
examples.description: This example customizes the screen reader announcement text by setting the accessibilityText, accessibilityDescription, and accessibilityLevel properties of the button on the right side of the SubHeaderV2 component.

examples.title: Example 9: Setting the Right-Side Button to Obtain Focus by Default
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set defaultFocus in SubHeaderV2 to ensure the right-side button obtains focus by default in the focused state.
The defaultFocus API is added to SubHeaderV2OperationItem since API version 18.
